requirement.requirement_text: The system runs every hour and searches Gmail for messages that have attachments and match the query 'invoice OR bill OR receipt'. It skips emails with no attachments and splits each email into individual items so each attachment is processed separately. For each PDF attachment the system shall: (1) extract the text from the PDF; (2) send the extracted text to an AI agent that returns invoice data as JSON; (3) parse and normalize the JSON into a consistent schema (for example invoice number, dates, vendor details, totals, and tax) and convert numeric values; (4) append the normalized invoice record to a Google Sheets tracker, using invoice_number as the matching column. Failure handling: not specified in the public description.
